## What is Weights AI?

Weights AI is an AI cover generator that runs in your browser. Pick one of 2,000+ community voices, or train a model of your own voice, upload a song, and get your AI cover in about a minute. Signing in gives you free credits to start, so you can try it without paying.

An AI cover, also called an AI song cover or AI voice cover, is an existing song sung in a different voice. The AI separates the vocal from the music, re-sings the vocal with the voice you pick, and puts the music back underneath. The melody, lyrics and timing stay the same; only the voice changes, which is how SpongeBob ends up singing Billie Jean in the demo above.

The voices are RVC voice models, each trained on recordings of one singer, character or speaker. They are shared by the community, and voices of real people are unofficial fan models.

## Tips for better AI covers

- 1 Songs with one clear lead vocal make the best AI covers; heavy harmonies and shouted ad-libs are harder.

- 2 Match the range: if the new voice is much higher or lower than the original singer, use the "Male â female" or "Female â male" pitch setting.

- 3 Studio recordings beat live versions, because crowd noise and reverb end up in the vocal.

- 4 If one model of a voice sounds off on your song, try another version of the same voice on its page.

- 5 Training your own voice? Record 10 minutes or more of a cappella singing in a quiet room.
